The mandate refuses stock and ETF additions while the loss measure is over the
  maximum loss or your sleeve is over its allocation, and option buys outside
  the premium limits. Its reduction is a set of proposals (canary proposals);
  the daemon places them itself only when mandate_reduction is pre-authorised,
  after the veto window.
